message.content: So the current HEAD (383512d5) does NOT include the fix commits. The vulnerability is a use-of-uninitialized-value in fuzzer_tool_flac. Let me look at the commit "aa414e46 Limit amount of samples to decode in fuzzer_tool_flac" which is likely the fix for issue 42529733.
